load_llm_model: load a pretrained causal language model and tokenizer from a model name or path using Hugging Face transformers
download_url_file: download a file from a URL to a local folder and return the file path
load_jsonl_data: load a JSONL file and return a list of dictionaries parsed from each line
greedy_generate_tokens: generate tokens greedily from a model using past key values and stream output word by word
review_streaming_utils: review the streaming utility functions for loading models, downloading files, parsing JSONL, and greedy token generation
